name: physique-meter
description: A physique baseline onboarding, scorecard, and metrics calculator app.

scripts.check: node -e "const { calculatePhysique } = require('./shared/physique'); const result = calculatePhysique({ sex: 'male', heightCm: 178, weightKg: 82, goalBodyFat: 14 }); if (!Number.isFinite(result.bodyFat)) process.exit(1); console.log('check ok');"
